title: ononis spinosa var. procurrens
intro: Ononis spinosa var. procurrens, commonly known as the Spiny Restharrow, is a type of plant in the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ononis spinosa var. procurrens include its potential to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and as a urinary tract antiseptic, helping to prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
